## Home Wi-Fi Troubleshooting Guide
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/wifi.svg
Experiencing slow internet or frequent disconnections at home? This guide provides simple steps to help non-technical users diagnose and fix common Wi-Fi issues. Often, a few basic checks can restore your connection.

## Wi-Fi Diagnostic Checklist

| Step | Action | What to Check | Expected Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1: Restart Devices** | Unplug your modem and router from power. Wait 30 seconds, then plug the modem back in. Once its lights stabilize, plug in the router. | Ensure all indicator lights on both devices turn on and stabilize (e.g., solid green for internet). | Internet connection restored; speed may improve. |
| **2: Check Cables** | Verify that all cables connected to your modem and router are securely plugged in. Pay close attention to the Ethernet cable connecting the modem to the router. | Look for loose connections or damaged cables. | Stable connection lights on devices; consistent internet. |
| **3: Reduce Distance & Obstacles** | Move your device (phone, laptop) closer to the Wi-Fi router and test the connection again. | Signal strength indicator on your device; internet speed. | Stronger Wi-Fi signal; potentially faster speeds. |
| **4: Minimize Interference** | Move your router away from other electronics like microwaves, cordless phones, baby monitors, or large metal objects. | Observe connection stability and speed after repositioning. | More reliable Wi-Fi signal with fewer drops. |
| **5: Update Firmware** | Access your router's settings page (usually by typing `192.168.1.1` or `192.168.0.1` into a web browser) and look for a "Firmware Update" section. | Consult your router's manual or manufacturer's website for specific instructions. | Improved performance, security, and bug fixes. |
| **6: Contact Your ISP** | If issues persist after trying the above steps, call your Internet Service Provider (ISP) for assistance. | Ask about local outages or line issues in your area. | ISP can diagnose external problems or dispatch a technician. |
